input: Kamoi et al. (2024) survey self-correction and report that no prior work shows successful self-correction with feedback from prompted LLMs except in tasks exceptionally suited to it, while self-correction works well with reliable external feedback and with large-scale fine-tuning. They propose a checklist for experiment design. Critique a claim that this survey proves self-correction never works.
source: Kamoi et al. 2024, Abstract and Conclusion (chunks kamoi2024-000, kamoi2024-030)
